Product overview

Braymil 1 is a Stage 1 infant formula developed for babies from birth to 6 months. It provides a balanced blend of age-appropriate nutrients and is positioned with a 60:40 whey-casein ratio, ALA, LA, iron, choline, vitamins and minerals.

The page is structured so the purchase decision and delivery information remain easy to scan at the top, while detailed product, ingredient, preparation and safety information sits below in a pharmacy-style long-form layout.

Directions for use

  • Use as advised by your healthcare practitioner.
  • Read the product label carefully before preparing a feed.
  • Use clean, sterilised equipment and follow the exact pack preparation method.
  • Follow the storage and post-opening directions printed on the pack.

Safety & important information

Mother’s milk is best for your baby. Infant formula should be used only on the advice of a healthcare professional.
  • Read the label carefully before use.
  • Store in a cool and dry place away from direct sunlight, as directed on pack.
  • Do not use a damaged or compromised pack.
  • Keep out of reach of children.
  • Use before the expiry date and follow post-opening storage directions.

Braymil 1 is positioned as a Stage 1 infant formula for babies from birth to 6 months. Follow the product label and advice of a healthcare professional.

Where should the exact feeding table appear?

The live page should reproduce the current approved feeding table from the product label in the Nutrition and Preparation section, not use estimated values.
